# GaiaWorks | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | Enterprise-level WFM for complex front-line labour, focused on intelligent scheduling, attendance, working hours costs and flexible working. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Not a complete core HR and local pay replacement; value dependent on business needs, scheduling rules and upstream/downstream data quality; project-type implementation heavy. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Not a complete core HR and local pay replacement; value depends on business needs, scheduling rules and upstream and downstream data quality; project-type implementation is heavier. |
